title: Sign in
subtitle: Use the email address your account was created with.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: An email address and a password are all it takes.
register.namesHint: Names are optional. You can add them later.
register.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

verify.title: Confirm your email address
verify.awaiting: Confirm your address to finish setting up your account. Follow the link in your inbox — or ask for a new one below.
verify.refused: This link cannot be used. It may already have been used, or it may have expired. Ask for a new one below.
verify.signedIn: You are already signed in. This link belongs to a different account: confirming it will sign this device out of the account you are using and into that one.

resend.sent: If that address is waiting to be confirmed, a new link is on its way. The previous link stops working.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: We will email you a link for choosing a new one.
forgot.sent: If that address has an account, a link is on its way. It can be used once and expires. The previous link stops working.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.refused: This link cannot be used. It may already have been used, or it may have expired.

confirmEmail.title: Confirm your new email address
confirmEmail.confirmed: Your email address has been changed. Use the new one to sign in from now on; the old one no longer works.
confirmEmail.taken: This address now belongs to another account, so it cannot be moved to yours. Ask for the change again with a different address.
confirmEmail.refused: This link cannot be used. It may already have been used, or it may have expired. Ask for the change again from your account.

google.title: Signing in with Google
google.signedIn: You are already signed in. Continuing will sign this device out of the account you are using and into the one you chose with Google.
google.refused: That sign-in did not work. It may have taken too long, or been finished in a different browser. Start again from the sign-in screen.
google.missing: There is nothing to finish here. Start again from the sign-in screen.
